steps.goal: Start a new sketch on the Top plane.
preconditions: A Part Studio is open and no tool dialog is active.

actions.target_description: The Top origin plane entry in the left feature tree.
actions.icon_description: A plane icon beside the label Top.
actions.expected_visible_result: The Top plane is highlighted in the canvas and feature tree.

actions.target_description: The Sketch button in the top Part Studio toolbar.
actions.icon_description: A small sketch/page icon with the visible label Sketch.
actions.semantic_action: Create a sketch on the selected Top plane.
actions.expected_visible_result: Sketch mode opens looking normal to the Top plane.

concise.text: Select the Top plane and start a sketch.

detailed.text: I will select the Top plane and open a new sketch on it.

dynamic_corrections.retry: I will locate the Top plane again.
dynamic_corrections.target_relocated: The control moved, so I will relocate it.
dynamic_corrections.validation_failed: Sketch mode did not open, so I will pause.
dynamic_corrections.user_interrupt: You took control, so I will stop.

steps.expected_end_state: A new sketch is active on the Top plane.
uncertainties: Toolbar positions may vary with window width.

steps.goal: Draw a centered circle and constrain it to a 25 mm radius.
preconditions: A sketch is active on the Top plane and the origin is visible.

actions.target_description: The center-point Circle tool in the sketch toolbar.
actions.icon_description: A circle outline icon in the sketch geometry toolbar.
actions.expected_visible_result: The Circle tool is active and awaits a center point.

actions.target_description: The sketch origin where the red horizontal axis and green vertical axis intersect.
actions.icon_description: A small origin point at the crossing of the red and green axes.
actions.semantic_action: Place the circle center exactly on the sketch origin.
actions.expected_visible_result: A circle preview follows the pointer from the origin.

actions.ui_region: sketch canvas immediately right of the origin
actions.target_description: A blank point on the red horizontal sketch axis roughly 100 pixels to the right of the origin, creating a clearly visible circle without touching the canvas edges.
actions.expected_visible_result: A complete circle centered at the origin is visible.

actions.target_description: The Sketch dimension tool in the sketch toolbar.
actions.icon_description: A dimension icon, often showing a diagonal measurement.
actions.expected_visible_result: The cursor is ready to select sketch geometry for a dimension.

actions.target_description: The circumference of the newly drawn circle, away from the origin and axes.
actions.semantic_action: Select the circle for dimensional constraint.
actions.expected_visible_result: A diameter or radial dimension preview follows the pointer.

actions.ui_region: sketch canvas above and right of the circle
actions.target_description: A clear blank point just above and to the right of the circle where the dimension label will be readable.
actions.expected_visible_result: A dimension value editor appears.

actions.target_description: The active numeric dimension input for the selected circle.
actions.semantic_action: Set the circle diameter to 50 mm, constraining its radius to 25 mm.
actions.expected_visible_result: The circle shows a 50 mm diameter dimension and is constrained to a 25 mm radius.

concise.text: Draw the circle at the origin, then dimension it to a 25 millimetre radius.

detailed.text: I will draw a center-point circle on the origin, apply a diameter dimension of 50 millimetres, and thereby constrain its radius to 25 millimetres.

dynamic_corrections.retry: I will locate the circle target again.
dynamic_corrections.target_relocated: The sketch view moved, so I will relocate the origin.
dynamic_corrections.validation_failed: The circle was not created correctly, so I will pause.
dynamic_corrections.user_interrupt: You took control, so I will stop.

steps.expected_end_state: A centered circle is constrained by a 50 mm diameter dimension, giving a 25 mm radius.
uncertainties: Onshape may display circle dimensions as diameter rather than radius; 50 mm diameter equals 25 mm radius.

steps.goal: Finish and accept the circle sketch.
preconditions: The centered circle is visible in the active sketch.

actions.ui_region: upper-right corner of the sketch dialog or toolbar
actions.target_description: The green checkmark button that accepts and closes the active sketch.
actions.expected_visible_result: Sketch mode closes and Sketch 1 appears in the feature tree.

detailed.text: I will accept the centered circle sketch.

dynamic_corrections.retry: I will locate the accept button again.
dynamic_corrections.target_relocated: The button moved, so I will relocate it.
dynamic_corrections.validation_failed: The sketch did not close, so I will pause.
dynamic_corrections.user_interrupt: You took control, so I will stop.

steps.expected_end_state: Sketch 1 is committed and visible in the feature tree.
uncertainties: The accept control can appear in a floating sketch dialog.

steps.goal: Create a central construction axis in a sketch on the Front plane.
preconditions: Sketch 1 is committed and contains the dimensioned circle.

actions.target_description: The Front origin plane entry in the left feature tree.
actions.icon_description: A plane icon beside the label Front.
actions.expected_visible_result: The Front plane is highlighted.

actions.target_description: The Sketch button in the top Part Studio toolbar.
actions.icon_description: A sketch/page icon with the label Sketch.
actions.semantic_action: Create a second sketch on the Front plane.
actions.expected_visible_result: Sketch mode opens looking normal to the Front plane.

actions.target_description: The Construction toggle in the sketch toolbar.
actions.expected_visible_result: Construction mode is active.

actions.target_description: The Line tool in the sketch toolbar.
actions.expected_visible_result: The line tool awaits its first point.

actions.target_description: A point on the horizontal sketch axis well to the left of the origin.
actions.semantic_action: Place the first endpoint of the revolution axis.
actions.expected_visible_result: A construction-line preview starts.

actions.target_description: A point on the same horizontal sketch axis well to the right of the origin, making the line pass exactly through the origin.
actions.semantic_action: Place the second endpoint of the central revolution axis.
actions.expected_visible_result: A horizontal construction line passes through the origin.

actions.target_description: The active sketch canvas after drawing the construction line.
actions.expected_visible_result: The construction axis remains and no new line preview is active.

actions.target_description: The green checkmark that accepts the active Front-plane sketch.
actions.expected_visible_result: Sketch 2 is committed in the feature tree.

concise.text: On the Front plane, draw a horizontal construction axis through the origin.

detailed.text: I will open a second sketch on the Front plane, enable construction geometry, and draw a horizontal centerline through the origin. This line lies on the intersection with the Top plane, so it can drive the revolve.

dynamic_corrections.retry: I will locate the Front plane and construction controls again.
dynamic_corrections.target_relocated: The sketch controls moved, so I will relocate them.
dynamic_corrections.validation_failed: The centerline was not created through the origin, so I will pause.
dynamic_corrections.user_interrupt: You took control, so I will stop.

steps.expected_end_state: Sketch 2 contains a horizontal construction line through the origin on the Front plane.
uncertainties: Construction and Line controls may be grouped differently at narrow widths.

steps.goal: Revolve the dimensioned circle around the construction axis from Sketch 2.
preconditions: Sketch 1 contains the 50 mm diameter circle.
Sketch 2 contains the central construction axis.

actions.target_description: Sketch 1 containing the dimensioned circle in the feature tree.
actions.expected_visible_result: Sketch 1 is highlighted.

actions.target_description: The Revolve feature button in the top toolbar.
actions.icon_description: A curved rotational arrow around a profile.
actions.semantic_action: Open Revolve with Sketch 1 as the profile.
actions.expected_visible_result: The Revolve dialog opens.

actions.target_description: The empty Revolve axis selection field.
actions.expected_visible_result: The dialog waits for an axis.

actions.target_description: The horizontal construction line through the origin from Sketch 2.
actions.icon_description: A dashed horizontal sketch line through the origin.
actions.semantic_action: Select the central construction line as the revolution axis.
actions.expected_visible_result: A 360-degree revolved preview appears.

actions.target_description: The Full revolution option or 360-degree angle control in the Revolve dialog.
actions.expected_visible_result: The preview shows a complete revolution.

actions.target_description: The green checkmark that accepts the Revolve feature.
actions.expected_visible_result: Revolve 1 appears in the feature tree.

concise.text: Revolve the circle through 360 degrees around the construction axis.

detailed.text: I will select the dimensioned circle profile, open Revolve, choose the construction line from Sketch 2 as the central axis, set a full 360-degree revolution, and accept the feature.

dynamic_corrections.retry: I will locate the profile and construction axis again.
dynamic_corrections.target_relocated: The selection moved, so I will relocate it.
dynamic_corrections.validation_failed: The revolve preview is not valid, so I will pause.
dynamic_corrections.user_interrupt: You took control, so I will stop.

steps.expected_end_state: Revolve 1 is committed from the dimensioned circle around Sketch 2’s central construction axis.
uncertainties: Sketch 2 may need to be made visible before its construction line can be selected.
